history_details: Three native reference blocks and three complete ambiguity sets change six existing descriptors and append two native inline events. Preserve all six stocks SRCHD03/04/05/07/06/02, including repeated NCBI species IDs as distinct occurrences; retain genus-only SRCHD06 without a species choice. Partial 16S source identification and native generic reference populations do not establish exact study-stock genomes, experimental abundances or candidate probabilities. Preserve all source quotations, conditions, graphs and old history. The 94.41 percent biofilm observation, 95.26 percent suspended Table 2 result, 50 versus 100 mg/L source discrepancy, ammonia-production distinction and post-irradiation community-recovery limitations remain unchanged. No claim of formal equivalence or survival of every original stock is added. The retained crosswalk release remains unestablished. This partial technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
